content: Lighthouse CI: assert Core Web Vitals thresholds (LCP <=2.5s, CLS <=0.1, INP <=200ms) and performance-budget.json (byte budgets per resource type) as CI gates failing PRs on regression; measure on a stable URL (seeded fixture detail page) desktop+mobile; Next.js fixes: server-render content, code-split charts, optimize images/fonts, cache API fetches, reduce client JS; treat score as means not end - track metric deltas before/after.
